description: Georgia O'Keeffe walking up onto beach with Marshall Gerard following. The 'young man' guide is at wall.  This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River'.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe and Others Walking onto Shore
